B.10.2
Signal/Service Translation Behavior
B.10.2.1
Optional Structure Element in the context of Signal/Service Translation
Figure B.45 illustrates the usage of update-bits in the source ISignalIPdu as the
cause for the definition of isOptional members of the event.
The left part of Figure B.45 shows that the signal group x1, signal y, and signal z have
update-bits defined and thus the resulting event definition for the ServiceInterface
needs to respect this. In this example the event xyz is defined as an Application-
RecordDataType containing 3 ApplicationRecordElements where each ele-
ment has the attribute isOptional set to true.
The right part of Figure B.45 takes one specific ISignalIPdu instance with only the
updateBit_y set to 1, thus only the signal y shall be considered as updated. There-
fore the resulting event notification contains an event xyz where only the member y is
defined. The other two members of xyz are not set in this example.
